$comment: COPY → ~/.paseo-pi-team/jobs.local.json (or edit it in the WebUI under Cấu hình → Công việc). A job is a PRESET a Lead reads with 'pteam jobs list' / 'pteam jobs show <id>'; it seats nothing itself — a Lead seats each usable executor (pteam jobs resolve <id> prints the exact create_agent arguments) and names the job in the 'team.job' label, and the create_agent gate then accepts the provider/model/thinking of an active executor of that job (a route executor needs 'thinking' to be seatable). Without that label the gate checks the declared class's route as before. Each job lists one or more executors, and ALL ENABLED ones are used (quick switches: 'enabled': false on a job or an executor, or a tool name in 'disabledTools' — a switched-off step is skipped, never replaced by another; the file is read on every use, so a switch is live without restarting Paseo): kind 'class' = whatever route that MODEL_CLASS has on this host now; kind 'route' = an explicit paseoProvider/model (thinking optional), same shapes as model-routing.local.json; kind 'cli' = a CLI tool, built-in 'pi' and 'claude' or one declared under cliTools. run 'sequential' means in the listed order — never 'try the next one when the previous failed'. Job ids and cliTools names: letters, digits, '_' and '-' only (no dots). Values below are placeholders.
